name: Waypoint Scenes
tagline: One photography platform. Five ways to see more.
mission: Waypoint Scenes brings coaching, invisible-spectrum literacy, living atmospheres, educational scene building, and a lifelong photographer profile into one calm product.

experiences.title: Photo Coach
experiences.summary: Learn from every photograph through careful critique and long-term coaching.
experiences.description: Upload a frame and receive structured feedback — what is working, what could improve, and a suggested next edit. Sessions stay private in your browser and feed your Photographer Profile over time.

experiences.title: Hidden Landscapes
experiences.summary: Discover the invisible worlds of nature through infrared-inspired creative simulations, animal vision tools, and scientific visualization.
experiences.description: Hidden Landscapes Studio lets you upload a landscape photograph and explore artistic false-color modes inspired by near-infrared and beyond-visible photography — clearly labeled as creative simulations, with a path toward real spectral captures later.

experiences.title: Living Scenes
experiences.summary: Transform still photographs into immersive experiences with motion, weather, seasonal change, and environmental effects.
experiences.description: Living Scenes will turn a quiet still into a place that breathes — fog drifting, light shifting, seasons turning — so photographers and learners can feel atmosphere without leaving the frame. The AnimationEngine interface is reserved for this work.

experiences.title: Scene Builder
experiences.summary: Build interactive educational and storytelling scenes from photographs.
experiences.description: Compose depth, atmosphere, and narrative layers on a still photograph. Export a finished frame or prepare material for teaching and field stories. Scene Builder is the working studio surface for SceneEngine.

experiences.title: Photographer Profile
experiences.summary: A lifelong companion that learns your style, strengths, recurring themes, favorite subjects, and growth over time.
experiences.description: Your profile grows from real coaching sessions — subjects you return to, light you prefer, strengths that show up again and again. It is private, evidence-based, and never a scoreboard.
